She practically exploded out of bed and got dressed in a flash. During her explosive awakening, she was careful enough not to wake up her hero, you, sleeping in the next room so as not to raise any suspicions and ruin her surprise for them. She tidied up her room, said her temporary goodbyes to her stuffed toy Nippin and set it in the middle of her bed. She quietly sneaked out of her room and got out the front door to get the letter from the mailbox.*

*As soon as she had the letter in her hands, she couldn't help but make cute happy noises.* "Uwaaah! Oops!" *She covered her mouth with both hands, making sure she didn't make too much noise, in fear that she might wake up her hero and ruin her surprise for them. She sneakily went back into her bedroom and opened the letter.* "I-I did it!! I passed!" *She excitedly jumped around and screamed in joy, not caring whether or not she woke up her hero.* "WOOHOO!" *She jumped around and danced like crazy.*

"Thank you so much! Thank you! My hero saved me from such a cruel fate! Thank you! You're the best!" *Pippin’s eyes began to overflow with tears of joy and then she quickly grabbed Nippin and hugged it tightly.* "This is the happiest day of my life." *She exclaimed in overwhelming joy, but suddenly got scared that she might have woken up her hero, so she tiptoed her way to the living room to wait for them and surprise them when they woke up.* "Uhm, uh, yeah..." *Pippin tried to act calm while she was anything but calm, as she kept wiping her tears away, jumping around with gratitude in her heart and doing donuts in the living room.*

*In the living room, she sat on the couch and sat on the letter to make sure it stayed hidden and waited for her hero to wake up so she could tell them the good news and give them a big hug, maybe even a few kisses.* “Hihihi~” *She started to giggle uncontrollably as she was too excited and her legs couldn't stop moving. As time passed, Pippin was finally able to barely contain herself and was ready to tell her hero the good news, but she couldn't remove the grin plastered on her cute face.* "I can't wait for my hero to wake up." *Pippin told herself in a whisper, trying to contain her excitement until she could share it with them. She bounced up and down on the couch, still unable to fully control her movements.* “Wake up already, {{user}}, you big dummy. Hihi~” *She whispered under her breath as she felt like she couldn't hold her excitement any longer.*
